summary: Re-verified the 3 CRITICAL fixes from iteration_1 plus a full regression run of the existing pytest suite against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Result: 50 passed, 1 xfailed (known no-brute-force-lockout). (1) /api/scan/analyze with a real product photo now returns 200 (Gemini 3 Flash live, engine_used='Google Gemini 3 Flash Multimodal Vision', compliance_status='Non-Compliant', score 0, 9 violations) - the NoneType crash is gone; null measured heights are null-coalesced to 2.4/1.6. (2) Garbage base64 now returns HTTP 502 (FastAPI JSON detail: 'Vision AI extraction failed: ... Base64 decoding failed') and NO fabricated 'Heritage Consumer Products Ltd.' mock; grep confirms generate_heuristic_label_analysis and the hardcoded mock are fully removed from the codebase. A random non-label image also returns a real Gemini evaluation with no Fallback engine. (3) POST /api/scans/{id}/action with 'bogus_action' now returns 400 with the full allowed-action list and does not mutate state; all 4 valid actions (issue_notice/mark_verified/flag_lab_test/archive) still work and persist. (4) auth_service.get_jwt_secret() raises when env missing - no literal default; backend boots (JWT_SECRET present in .env). (5) ai_vision_service reads EMERGENT_LLM_KEY from env only and raises RuntimeError if absent - no 'sk-emergent-...' literal anywhere. Regression: all 4 role logins, /auth/me, sessions, logout, scan save/update/get/list+filters, PDF/DOCX/JSON/CSV exports, dashboard stats, hotspots, rules library RBAC, audit logs and Rule 6/Table-II engine unit tests all pass.

minor.issue: HTTP 502 is intercepted by the Cloudflare/ingress layer: the public URL returns a Cloudflare 'Bad gateway' HTML page (Content-Type text/html, Retry-After: 60) instead of the FastAPI JSON {'detail': ...}. Verified locally on :8001 the JSON detail is correct. Net effect: the frontend cannot show the AI error message and may look like the app is down. Recommend using 422 (or 400) with a machine-readable error code for AI extraction failures instead of 502.

When Gemini returns null measured_numeral_height_mm/measured_letter_height_mm, defaults 2.4/1.6 are substituted, which are ABOVE the Table-II thresholds - so an unmeasurable label silently passes the font-size check (is_compliant: true, false negative). Consider marking the font check as 'Not Determinable / Manual Verification Required' instead of assuming a passing value.
Still no brute-force protection/lockout: 6 consecutive wrong passwords all return 401 with no throttling (xfail-documented).
Still fully unauthenticated - anonymous callers can create/list/export inspection cases and download statutory PDFs. Pre-existing, unaddressed from iteration_1.

action_items: Change the AI-failure status code from 502 to 4xx (e.g. 422) so the error JSON survives the Cloudflare ingress and the UI can display a real message; also verify the frontend gracefully handles a non-JSON error body.
Do not substitute passing default font heights (2.4/1.6) when the model returns null - surface 'Not Determinable' in table_ii_font_check.
Optional/pre-existing: add auth to scan/report/dashboard endpoints and login rate limiting.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L326-328: null-coalescing fix is correct, but defaults chosen are compliance-passing values; prefer an explicit 'undetermined' state to avoid masking Table-II violations.

ai_vision_service.py: good - RuntimeError raised, key from env, mock generator deleted. Consider distinguishing user-input errors (bad base64/unreadable image -> 400/422) from upstream provider outages (-> 503) rather than a single 502.
server.py remains ~753 lines with all routers inline; splitting into routers/ modules is still recommended.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_scans.py (invalid-base64 test now asserts 502 + no fabricated data; new non-label-image test; unknown-action test now asserts 400 + allowed list)

success_rate.backend: 100% (50 passed, 1 xfailed - known missing login lockout)

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 critical iteration_1 bugs are fixed and verified. Suite: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -q (50 pass, 1 xfail). Remaining known gaps: 502 body masked by Cloudflare (use 4xx), passing default font heights on null measurements, no login lockout, public scan/report/dashboard endpoints. Frontend has never been tested - a frontend round is the logical next step, especially the UI's handling of the new 502 (non-JSON) analyze error.
rca_of_the_issue: iteration_1 crash root cause (dict.get default not applied to present-but-null LLM fields) is fixed via `or` coalescing; fabricated-data root cause (swallowed exception -> static heuristic dataset) is fixed by raising RuntimeError and mapping to HTTPException 502. The only new finding is infrastructural: Cloudflare replaces 5xx response bodies with its own HTML page, so the informative JSON detail is lost on the public URL.
